name: County Road 5328 Access
description: A county road access on the upper Big Piney, above Simmons Ford and Baptist Camp. The upper river is small and runs best after rain.
road_access: Texas County Road 5328, just off US 63.
facilities: No facilities. The land around it is private.

name: Henry River Access
description: A Forest Service road access on Mark Twain National Forest land, about a mile below Boiling Spring.
road_access: Forest Road 1538, a gravel road suitable for passenger cars and open all year. The access is at the end of the road.
facilities: No facilities. Some neighboring land is private.

name: High Log Eddy
description: A primitive access at the end of the High Log Eddy road, on Mark Twain National Forest land between Warren Bridge and Slabtown.
road_access: Forest Road 255 (High Log Eddy), a gravel road suitable for passenger cars and open all year. Follow it to the end at the river.

name: Forest Road 1794 Access
description: Where Forest Road 1794 reaches the Big Piney on Mark Twain National Forest land, about a mile and a half above Horse Camp.
road_access: Forest Road 1794, a gravel Forest Service road maintained for high-clearance vehicles.

name: County Road 5117 Bridge
description: County road bridge between Baptist Camp and Dogs Bluff. Access is from the road right-of-way only; the land around it is private.
parking_info: No parking. Don't block the road.
